note: Access on a bend of the One Hundred and Two River northeast of Savannah. The one primitive camping spot is at the far end of a ~650 m lane from the County Road 182 lot, beside a small gravel lot in the woods near the river; MDC's map draws the lane as a dirt road. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Individual Campsites', Rule 140 standard; brochure 'Camping is permitted only within areas designated by signs or brochures'; map (07/07) one Primitive Camping Area symbol beside the end lot = GIS 116, 28 m from lot 71. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual. Pin nudged from the grass beside the lot onto lot 71. Not waterfront kept (river ~80 m through woods). Phone matches. Access lane shown as dirt road on the map (looks graveled on imagery) - flagged.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Individual Campsites'; Rule 140 standard text, no permit rule. Brochure: 'Camping is permitted only within areas designated by signs or brochures. Camping is designated primitive... Only two camping or sleeping units are permitted at each site on areas with established campsites.' Map (07/07) legend 'Primitive Camping Area'; one symbol, beside the parking lot at the end of the access lane (= GIS 116, 28 m from lot 71). A designated point beside a lot - stays. Imagery: lot 71 is a small gravel pull-off ~15 x 40 m at the lane's end; the camp point is the grass clearing at its north tip. No horse camp, ford or rig wording.

ACCESS (check): the ~650 m lane from lot 72 on County Road 182 to the camp lot is drawn on MDC's map as 'Dirt Road' (legend), not gravel; leaf-off imagery shows a pale, graveled-looking single lane with no crossings. No 4WD or closure wording on the page or brochure. Kept, but a wet-weather caveat is in the note.
PIN: stored 40.01291,-94.79663 = GIS 116, in the grass ~28 m NE of the lot. Nudge onto lot 71: 40.01276,-94.79689.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the One Hundred and Two River is ~80 m NE of the lot through a wooded bank; the ponds nearby are small 'fishless ponds' (under 5 acres).
CLUSTERS: one camp only; lot 72 at the road (600 m) is a parking lot with no camping symbol. near.py: nothing else within 3 km.
PHONE: area page 'For more information call (816) 271-3100' matches stored.
